text: The CREWS Cambodia and Lao PDR project is a four-year initiative aimed at enhancing multi-hazard early warning systems with a focus on hydrometeorological risks such as droughts, floods, and severe weather. It operates through national and international partnerships to strengthen the capacities of meteorological and hydrological services, improve risk assessments, and enhance communication and response capabilities. The project is part of the global CREWS Initiative, supporting least developed countries and small island developing states in establishing risk-informed early warning services.

metadata.solution_name: Reinforcing the capacities of meteorological and hydrological services and enhancing the early warning systems in Cambodia and Lao PDR (CREWS Cambodia and Lao PDR)
